steps.content: Broken Frontline, DisSea

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: NOX... is right ahead.
You've already been chasing after Amber for two hours. Just now, she's crossed the Broken Frontline and entered the deepest part of DisSea.
The shackles connecting you to Amber are also reminding you that she's right there.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That place is an area absolutely forbidden for the living. You... shouldn't go there.
You point at the safety cable for transporting goods on the side, offering your solution.
Tie that around me. Once I give the signal, you'll pull me back.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I understand you don't want to give up on any Sinner.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But this... will only cost you your life for nothing.
You know the shackles can defend against the Black Ring's corruption.
Also, I've promised Amber I'd take her to see the sunrise. I don't have a habit of breaking promises.
Nightingale is staring into your eyes without speaking a word for a while.
At last, she ties the cable around you silently.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: If you notice anything unusual, please send the signal at once.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You must not... hesitate.
Pressing on the cable around your waist, you trudge in the mud along a ford.
Amber!
The more you go forward, the more faded the colors of all the surroundings seem, only the cold red moon above is becoming more and more clear and blinding.
As you advance, more and more figures emerge around you. They're standing still, staring at the blood-red moon-adorned sky blankly.
Under the sky, something is gradually peeling off from you.
Fresh... Fresh...
Memories of the living...
As if smelling something, the dazed figures are flaring their nostrils greedily, mumbling.
Amber!
Without hesitation, you continue shouting the girl's name and advancing the best you can, but the silt under your feet and the unknown filth hidden in it are hindering you.
Stumbling, you fall into the lake. Colorful ripples spread across the water surface.
I remember now.
I was alive once too.
We've been dead for too long...

You stand up. Mysterious colors keep spreading into the water. You notice you've forgotten the meaning of the mumbling crowd behind you and the line of fortifications appeared out of nowhere, but you must keep going.
You've lost track of time walking, until you finally see that familiar figure.
Amber, I'm here.

The object around your waist makes you uneasy, and your body and mind are both growing heavy. You're not sure why you're wearing such a burdensome thing on you, but your instinct tells you to never remove it.
There's no sunrise here. You must go back with me.
Amber turns back slowly.
There's not a hint of Amber in those eyes.
Hahahaha!
You hear frantic cackles from behind. After swallowing the colors peeled off from your body, those who're following you are showing blatant malice in their eyes.
We've told you, we've told you!
She died a long time ago!
With her memories and all of our deaths, we created an illusion of DisSea.
We've already deceived the rules, deceived DisSea, and yet here you are!
The moon above you is hanging lower and lower, staring at what's happening on the lake coolly.
You finally understand what the red moon signifies—the real DisSea, the cold rules, the start and the end of the Mania, and the final fate of everyone.
Those who're infected with the Mania belong to DisSea after they die. There are no exceptions.
You've killed her, you've killed us.
And you're about to kill yourself.
Seeing that you've chosen death yourself, I guess you no longer need these living memories.
They're ours now!
The faces of the surrounding figures are growing more and more distorted, developing flesh lumps and fangs like Corruptors. They're crowding around you.
Some are tearing at the steel cable behind you and some are catching the spreading colors on the lake surface.
Even more of them are coming toward you.
You must run... You should send someone... a signal...
To whom? What's the signal? What is... this place?
Should I go back? Go back where?
You try your best to think, but the answer never comes.
No, I can't go back, Amber is still here...
You can't understand what the clamorous crowd is saying.
Your consciousness is growing heavier and big chunks of blanks appear in your memories, like rocks eroded by the wind, turned into colorful sand and scattered into the lake.
The colors have finally touched the girl in front of you.
${PlayerName}?
The girl turns back. Her eyes have regained clarity and brightness.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Why are you here?
Are you... Amber?
I'm here... to take you back... to see the sunrise.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: You shouldn't have come here.
I can't... break my promise.
Follow me... Hurry up! Time is running short.
Crack!
You hear the sound of metal shattering from behind.
Amber is looking at you, tears streaming down her cracked cheeks, dripping down into the lake.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I thought... there would perhaps be a little bit of time left, even if it's only one day... At least I could see them... and the sunrise...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Well... now is not the time for this.
A dazzling smile reemerges on the girl's face.
She stares into your eyes and solemnly says that name that makes you feel both strange and familiar.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Thank you.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Thank you, for making me recall everything about being a human.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Even though I've done so many... unforgivable things...

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Thank you... for coming to me when I was feeling the most hopeless...
You don't understand what the girl is saying, but an instinctive worry makes you grip her hand.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Since many years ago, this place has been my destined home. This is an inevitable truth no matter how I try to defy it.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I should have known better. That would have prevented so many mistakes from happening.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: But at least there's still something I can do now.
The surrounding monsters have already lurked next to you, but all of your attention is on the girl before you.
She grips your hands tight.
You open your mouth but are at a loss of words.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: I can't protect you, but perhaps... she can.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Live on, live well.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: Farewell...
The girl's figure shatters and turns into starlight, brightening up the sky.
Amid that, the monster holding the longsword once again emerges.
It's a nightmare too long and too desperate. When you wake up, Amber is carrying you and walking toward the Broken Frontline.
Even though her skin is ice cold, you feel relieved for having survived the disaster.
Are we... safe now?
Amber doesn't say a word, and only keeps moving forward silently.
On the Broken Frontline, Nightingale is impatiently ordering the others to drop the cable.
Behind them, the warm, golden morning sun is slowly rising.
Amber, it's the sunrise.
Amber?
You look up. No reaction can be seen on the ashen face, as if everything before you, even the sunrise she's been longing to see, has nothing to do with her.
It is an ice cold, empty vessel named NOX.
